description: A number passes formula recognition at size \(n\) exactly when it codes a shared scoped formula whose two free-name families represent original variables and auxiliary names.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixed_recognition_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (n e : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.isForm S n e = true ↔
    ∃ a, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixedCode S a = e
